column3: “of Israel” renders “in Israel”; “allotted to them as a possession” renders “fallen to it as an inheritance.”
“family” renders “tribe”; “out of their whole number” renders “from their ends,” and “valiant men” renders “sons of strength.”
“Thus and so” renders “like this and like this.”
“has the Lord’s approval” renders “is before the LORD,” with a lowercase “Lord.”
“no ruler humiliating them for anything” interprets a difficult Hebrew clause; the meaning is uncertain.
NASB renders “and you are inactive” as a question, “will you sit still?”
“the graven image, the ephod” renders “the carved image of the ephod.”
“What is the matter with you” renders “What is to you.”
“fierce men” renders “men bitter of soul”; “lose your life” renders “gather your life.”
“quiet” renders “at peace”; “the edge of the sword” renders “the mouth of the sword.”
“no one to deliver them” renders “no deliverer.”
“Manasseh” follows the Hebrew, where a raised letter turns “Moses” into “Manasseh”; “the captivity of the land” renders “the land went into exile.”
